payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linear scan over number of items taken from left; for each split, compute cost using prefix sums and add penalty based on the difference in counts, assuming optimal alternating pick order.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates all possible split points. For each, it uses a greedy exchange–based formula (alternating minimizes consecutive same-hand penalties) to directly compute the minimal cost for that split. No backtracking or DP; the dominant idea is the greedy cost calculation.
